title: Origination
summary: ORIGINA'TION, noun 1 The act of bringing or coming into existence; first production. Descartes first introduced the fancy of making a world, and deducing the origination of the universe from mechanica

inlines.v: ORIGINA'TION, noun 1 The act of bringing or coming into existence; first production. Descartes first introduced the fancy of making a world, and deducing the origination of the universe from mechanical principles. 2. Mode of production or bringing into being. This eruca is propagated by animal parents, to wit, butterflies, after the common origination of all caterpillars.
